connector.name: MCP Server by echosaw.com
connector.registryDescription: Media intelligence analysis for audio, video, and images via the Echosaw MCP server.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.echosaw.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.echosaw. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
